evals.prompt:
From these labelled reqs, produce a tagged Umple model and Java code.
req R01 { A person has a name. }
evals.expected_output: Uses requirements-tracer then code-generator: req/implementsReq plus a Java API call.
expectations: The agent reads or follows umple-requirements-tracer
The Umple source contains req R01 and implementsReq
The API is called with language=Java at least once
The API response does not contain umple-message-error

evals.prompt: Draw a state model of a door Open/Closed, then add a main that toggles it.
evals.expected_output: Diagram (or state Umple) plus a main that fires events.
expectations: The agent treats 'state model' as a state machine (diagram-generator or equivalent)
The Umple source contains Open and Closed states
The API response does not contain umple-message-error
